mapper.sql: select c.change_id, c.library_id, c.tag_id, c.base_version, c.change_type, c.before_json, c.after_json, c.source_before, c.source_after, c.revision, c.status, c.apply_by, c.submit_time, c.audit_by, c.audit_time, c.audit_comment, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, t.field_name, t.tag_name, l.library_name from tl_tag_metadata_change c left join tl_tag t on t.tag_id = c.tag_id left join tl_tag_library l on l.library_id = c.library_id
mapper.insert: insert into tl_tag_metadata_change ( library_id, tag_id, base_version, change_type, before_json, after_json, source_before, source_after, revision, status, apply_by, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{libraryId}, #{tagId}, #{baseVersion}, #{changeType}, #{beforeJson}, #{afterJson}, #{sourceBefore}, #{sourceAfter}, #{revision}, #{status}, #{applyBy}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.select:
where c.status = 'DRAFT' and c.apply_by = #{creator} and c.tag_id in
#{tagId}

c.status = 'PENDING' and c.library_id = #{libraryId} and t.tag_name like concat('%', #{tagName}, '%') and t.field_name like concat('%', #{fieldName}, '%') and c.apply_by like concat('%', #{applyBy}, '%')
order by c.submit_time
mapper.delete: delete from tl_tag_metadata_change where change_id = #{changeId} and status = 'DRAFT'
